guides.title: Circa customer journey

findings.problem: Fixed customer ports, credentials, model, dataset and historical live narratives were presented as accelerator instructions.
findings.correction: Retained the useful owner journey while replacing deployment-specific assertions with reusable composition, governed reference adoption, owner links and an explicit source-only evidence boundary.

findings.problem: Universal fresh arrival and complete centre eligibility were implied without source wiring or algorithm coverage.
findings.correction: Made native Experience versus explicit Journey adapter selection visible, documented no default radius, inclusive distance/freshness bounds and optional accuracy, saved-draft preservation and completed-command replay. Public discovery is active/operating/public; Journey distance selection is not item-rule/opening-hour evaluation, and validateFacts does not independently enforce active or all acceptance templates.

findings.problem: Independent review and reward success were stronger than default policy and owner operations establish.
findings.correction: Recorded false defaults for requireScopes/requireVerification/requireDifferentApprover, real employee claims, revisions/idempotency, release/reclaim handoff, separate evidence-read authorization, pending settlement and optional communication. Valid qualified INPUT_ONLY coverage is distinct from mandatory rejection of missing/failed/mock/empty assessments.

findings.problem: Customer-specific Commerce and channel paths risked duplicating owners or implying live qualification.
findings.correction: Linked existing Product/Cart/Order/Returns/Location/Impact docs, preserved physical receipt and entitlement boundaries, described disabled channel defaults and authenticated account proof, and added a project radius/strict reviewer policy example with wiring, scope, test and rollback prerequisites.

findings.problem: Application enterprises, offer counts, login conventions and customer release selections were mistaken for reusable accelerator reference data.

findings.correction: Preserved explicit owner-only stock/issuance/rights/scope gates and linked Product/Cart docs without duplicating Commerce. Separated source test assertions from installed/native testing and normal parent publication.
